snippet.title: Carmen Sandiego Math Detective
snippet.description:
"Cutscenes" from the game Carmen Sandiego Math Detective by Broderbund. Sorry about the quality and lack of game audio; it was hard enough finding a screen recorder that could deal with the oldness of the game.
